ov: طفل روزماري (الإنجليزية: Rosemary's Baby) هو فيلم رعب تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1968. الفيلم من إخراج رومان بولانسكي.
plotEn:
Guy and Rosemary Woodhouse rent a recently vacated apartment in the Bramford, a large Gothic building in Manhattan, after the previous tenant, an elderly woman, fell into a coma and died. Guy and Rosemary ignore their friend Hutch's warning about the Bramford's dark past involving witchcraft and murder. Rosemary meets a young woman, Terry Gionoffrio, a recovering drug addict whom Minnie and Roman Castevet, the Woodhouses' elderly next-door neighbors, took in. Rosemary admires a pendant necklace the Castevets gave to Terry but dislikes its pungent odor. One night, Terry apparently jumps to her death from the Castevets' seventh-floor apartment. Soon the Castevets befriend Guy and Rosemary. Guy grows increasingly fond of them, but Rosemary finds them annoying and meddlesome. Minnie gives Terry's "tannis root" pendant to Rosemary as a "good luck charm".
Guy lands an important role in a play after the original actor inexplicably goes blind. With his career on track, Guy wants to have a baby with Rosemary. On the night they plan to conceive, Minnie brings them individual cups of chocolate mousse. Guy chastises Rosemary for complaining hers tastes odd. Shortly after, Rosemary loses consciousness and experiences a dreamlike vision in which a demonic entity rapes her while Guy, the Castevets, and other Bramford tenants—all nude—watch. The next morning, Rosemary's body is covered in scratches. Guy admits to raping her while she was unconscious since he did not want to miss "baby night"
